I'm testing edge cases for the line table, like a collapsed call with no result, and realizing I need a call with large enough arguments to actually trigger collapsing behavior rather than staying under the token threshold.

I'm also checking a failed bash call with empty error text, a call that asked a clarifying question with custom details, and a saveOnly call to confirm functions are hidden appropriately when that flag is set, while verifying the title falls back to the first line of the program when no label exists.

Now I'm testing the crowded case with 120 bound tool calls, confirming the collapsed description shows a token estimate and correctly falls back to listing originals via inspectEntry when the byte size exceeds the threshold.
